section.content: The machine learning method performs a data set dividing process of dividing a period into a learning period and a verification period and dividing the data set into learning data and verification data, a candidate learning period dividing process of dividing the candidate learning period into a plurality of divided learning periods, a learning period evaluating process of generating a learning period evaluating model for each divided learning period using learning data corresponding to the divided learning periods and calculating an evaluation index of the learning period evaluating model for each divided learning period using the verification data, a learning period selecting process of repeatedly performing the candidate learning period dividing process and the learning period evaluating process until a prescribed end condition is satisfied, selecting the divided learning period with the evaluation index being high as a learning object period when the end condition is satisfied, and a model outputting process of outputting a learning model in which machine learning is performed using the learning data corresponding to the learning object period.

机器学习方法进行以下处理：数据集分割处理，将期间划分成学习期间和验证期间，并将数据集分割成学习数据和验证数据；候补学习期间划分处理，将候补学习期间划分成多个分割学习期间；学习期间评估处理，使用与分割学习期间相对应的学习数据生成每个分割学习期间的学习期间评估模型，并使用验证数据计算出每个分割学习期间的学习期间评估模型的评估指标；学习期间选定处理，重复进行候补学习期间划分处理及学习期间评估处理直至满足规定的结束条件，在满足结束条件时，将评估指标高的分割学习期间选定为学习对象期间；和模型输出处理，输出使用与学习对象期间相对应的学习数据进行了机器学习的学习模型。

Machine learning method and machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present invention relates to a machine learning method and a machine learning apparatus.

Background

Conventionally, a method called Cross Validation (Cross Validation) has been used in machine learning data sets. Cross-validation is to divide a data set into learning data and validation data, perform machine learning of a learning model using the learning data, and evaluate performance of the learning model subjected to machine learning using the validation data (for example, refer to patent document 1 and patent document 2).

Prior art literature

Patent literature

Patent document 1 Japanese patent application laid-open No. 2019-003408

Patent document 2 Japanese patent application laid-open No. 2019-061565

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

When cross-validation is used, if the learning data includes specific data having a characteristic significantly different from other data, for example, the learning model performance may be degraded due to the influence of the specific data.

The present invention has been made in view of the above-described problems, and an object of the present invention is to provide a machine learning method and a machine learning device capable of improving performance of a learning model based on machine learning.

Means for solving the problems

In order to achieve the above object, a machine learning method according to an aspect of the present invention is a machine learning method for performing machine learning of a learning model using a data set in which data at each time point acquired according to a temporal change of a predetermined phenomenon is arranged in time series using a computer, wherein:

A data set dividing process of dividing the period into a learning period and a verification period, setting the learning period as an initial candidate learning period, and dividing the data set into learning data corresponding to the learning period and verification data corresponding to the verification period;

A candidate learning period dividing process of dividing the candidate learning period into a plurality of divided learning periods;

A learning period evaluation process of performing machine learning of the learning model for each of the divided learning periods using the learning data corresponding to the divided learning period, thereby generating a learning period evaluation model for each of the divided learning periods, and performing verification of the learning period evaluation model for each of the divided learning periods using the verification data, respectively, thereby calculating an evaluation index of the learning period evaluation model for each of the divided learning periods;

A learning period selection process of setting the divided learning period having the evaluation index as the next candidate learning period, repeating the candidate learning period division process and the learning period evaluation process until a predetermined end condition is satisfied, and selecting the divided learning period having the evaluation index as a learning target period when the end condition is satisfied, and

And model output processing for outputting, as a learning model, the learning model subjected to machine learning using the learning data corresponding to the learning target period.

A machine learning method according to another aspect of the present invention is a machine learning method for performing machine learning of a learning model by using a computer and using a data set in which data at each time point acquired according to a temporal change of a predetermined phenomenon is arranged in time series, wherein:

A data set dividing process of dividing the period into a learning period and a verification period, setting the learning period as an initial candidate learning period, and dividing the data set into learning data corresponding to the learning period and verification data corresponding to the verification period;

A learning data dividing process of dividing the learning period into a plurality of sub-learning periods and dividing the learning data into a plurality of sub-learning data corresponding to the plurality of sub-learning periods;

A candidate learning period dividing process of dividing the plurality of sub-learning periods included in the candidate learning period into a plurality of divided learning periods;

A learning period evaluation process of performing machine learning of the learning model for each of the divided learning periods by using the sub-learning data corresponding to the sub-learning period included in the divided learning period, thereby generating a learning period evaluation model for each of the divided learning periods, and performing verification of the learning period evaluation model for each of the divided learning periods by using the verification data, respectively, thereby calculating an evaluation index of the learning period evaluation model for each of the divided learning periods;

a learning period selection process of setting the divided learning period having the evaluation index as the next candidate learning period, repeating the candidate learning period division process and the learning period evaluation process until a predetermined end condition is satisfied, and selecting the sub-learning period included in the divided learning period having the evaluation index as a learning target period when the end condition is satisfied, and

And model output processing for outputting, as a learning model, the learning model subjected to machine learning using the sub-learning data corresponding to the learning object period.

Effects of the invention

According to the machine learning method of the aspect of the present invention, by the learning period selection process, the candidate learning period division process and the learning period evaluation process are repeated, whereby the divided learning period with the evaluation index of the learning period evaluation model being high is selected as the learning object period, and the machine learning of the learning model is performed using the learning data corresponding to the learning object period. Therefore, the performance of the learning model based on machine learning can be improved.

The problems, structures and effects other than those described above will be apparent from the modes for carrying out the invention described below.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, embodiments for carrying out the present invention will be described with reference to the drawings. In the following, the necessary ranges are schematically shown in the description for achieving the object of the present invention, and the ranges necessary for the description of the relevant portions of the present invention are mainly described, and the description of the portions based on the known art is omitted.

(Embodiment 1)

Fig. 1 is a block diagram showing an example of the machine learning device 1 according to embodiment 1. The machine learning device 1 is a device capable of executing a machine learning method S1 for performing machine learning of the learning model M using the data set D, and is constituted by a general-purpose or special-purpose computer (see fig. 2 described later), for example.

The data set D is configured by arranging data at each time point acquired according to the time-dependent change of a predetermined phenomenon in time series in a predetermined period P. The predetermined phenomenon is, for example, a phenomenon in which one or more variables representing the state of the observation target change with time, and may be, for example, a mechanical phenomenon, an electromagnetic phenomenon, a thermal phenomenon, a sound phenomenon, a chemical phenomenon, a physiological phenomenon, or the like, or may be a natural phenomenon or an economic phenomenon. The variables representing the states of the observation targets by the respective phenomena are measured by various sensors for a predetermined period of time, and the measured variables are digitized (digitized) as data, and collected and accumulated in time series order, thereby constituting the data set D used in the machine learning method S1. Further, the data set D may be collected in the past or may be collected in real time.

The machine learning device 1 includes, as its main components, a control unit 10, a storage unit 11, an input unit 12, an output unit 13, a communication unit 14, and a device connection unit 15.

The control unit 10 functions as the machine learning unit 100 by executing the machine learning program 110 stored in the storage unit 11, and executes various processes performed by the machine learning method S1. The storage unit 11 stores, for example, an Operating System (OS), other programs, data, and the like, in addition to the machine learning program 110 and various data used in the machine learning program 110. The input unit 12 receives various input operations, and the output unit 13 outputs various information via a display screen or voice, thereby functioning as a user interface. The communication unit 14 is connected to a wired or wireless network, and functions as a communication interface for transmitting and receiving various data between other devices (not shown). The device connection unit 15 functions as a connection interface with an external device such as a scanner or a printer, a measurement device such as a sensor, and a storage medium such as a USB memory, a CD-ROM, or a DVD.

In the machine learning method S1, machine learning of the learning model M is performed by using the data set D, and the learned model is provided to an arbitrary utilization system. In the case where the data set D is a data set based on a variable of a monitoring object or a control object in a machine or an apparatus (or one of the constituent members of the machine or the apparatus), for example, the learned model is used to estimate the state (abnormality, malfunction, sign thereof, or the like) of the monitoring object or control the control object by inputting an unknown variable (which may be collected in the past or in real time).

The learning model M is a model for implementing an arbitrary machine learning algorithm and machine learning method, and may be a model for processing a classification problem such as binary classification or multi-value classification, or may be a model for processing a regression problem. Examples of the learning model M include tree types such as decision trees and regression trees, ensemble learning such as Bagging (Bagging) and Boosting (Boosting), deep neural networks, regression neural networks, convolutional neural networks, neural networks such as LSTM (including deep learning), hierarchical clustering, non-hierarchical clustering, clustering such as k-nearest neighbor method and k-average method, multivariate analysis such as principal component analysis, factor analysis and logistic regression, and support vector machines, but are not limited to these examples. The learning model M may be applied to any one of teacher learning, non-teacher learning, and reinforcement learning as a machine learning method.

Fig. 2 is a hardware configuration diagram showing an example of the computer 200. The computer 200 is an example of a device constituting the machine learning device 1, and is configured as a general-purpose or special-purpose computer.

As shown in fig. 2, the computer 200 includes, as its main components, a bus 210, a processor 212, a memory 214, an input device 216, an output device 217, a display device 218, a storage 220, a communication I/F (interface) section 222, an external device I/F section 224, an I/O (input/output) device I/F section 226, and a medium input/output section 228. The above-described components may be appropriately omitted according to the application in which the computer 200 is used.

The processor 212 is configured by one or a plurality of arithmetic processing units (CPU (Central Processing Unit, central processing unit), MPU (Micro-processing unit), DSP (DIGITAL SIGNAL processor), GPU (Graphics Processing Unit, graphics processor), and the like, and operates as the control unit 10 of the entire computer 200. The memory 214 stores various data and programs 230, and is configured from, for example, a volatile memory (DRAM, SRAM, etc.) functioning as a main memory, a nonvolatile memory (ROM), a flash memory, etc.

The input device 216 is configured by, for example, a keyboard, a mouse, a numeric keypad, an electronic pen, and the like, and functions as the input unit 12. The output device 217 is configured by, for example, a sound (voice) output device, a vibration device, or the like, and functions as the output unit 13. The display device 218 is configured by, for example, a liquid crystal display, an organic EL display, electronic paper, a projector, or the like, and functions as the output unit 13. The input device 216 and the display device 218 may be integrally formed as a touch panel display. The storage device 220 is configured by, for example, an HDD (HARD DISK DRIVE ), an SSD (Solid STATE DRIVE), or the like, and functions as the storage unit 11. The storage 220 stores various data required for execution of the operating system and programs 230.

The communication I/F unit 222 is connected to a network 240 such as the internet or an intranet by wire or wireless, and functions as the communication unit 14 for transmitting and receiving data to and from other computers in accordance with a predetermined communication standard. The external device I/F section 224 is connected to an external device 250 such as a camera, a printer, a scanner, or a reader/writer by wire or wireless, and functions as a device connection section 15 for transmitting and receiving data to and from the external device 250 in accordance with a predetermined communication standard. The I/O device I/F unit 226 is connected to I/O devices 260 such as various sensors and actuators, and functions as a device connection unit 15 for transmitting and receiving various signals and data to and from the I/O devices 260, for example, based on detection signals of the sensors and control signals to the actuators. The medium input/output unit 928 is configured by a drive device such as a DVD (DIGITAL VERSATILE DISC) drive, a CD (Compact Disc) drive, a memory card slot, and a USB connector, and functions as the device connection unit 15 for reading and writing data from and to a medium (non-transitory storage medium) 970 such as a DVD, a CD, a memory card, and a USB memory.

In the computer 200 having the above-described structure, the processor 212 calls out the program 230 stored in the storage device 220 to the memory 214 to be executed, and controls the respective parts of the computer 200 via the bus 210. In addition, the program 230 may be stored in the memory 214 instead of the storage device 220. The program 230 may be recorded on the medium 270 in the form of an installable file or an installable file, and may be supplied to the computer 200 via the medium input/output unit 228. The program 230 may also be provided to the computer 200 by being downloaded via the communication I/F section 222 and the network 240. The computer 200 may also implement various functions implemented by executing the program 230 by the processor 212 using hardware such as an FPGA (field-programmable gate array) GATE ARRAY, an ASIC (application SPECIFIC INTEGRATED circuit), or the like.

The computer 200 is an electronic device of any form, for example, a fixed type computer or a portable type computer. The computer 200 may be a client-type computer, a server-type computer, or a cloud-type computer.

Next, details of the machine learning method S1 performed by the control section 10 (machine learning section 100) of the machine learning apparatus 1 having the above-described configuration will be described with reference to fig. 3 to 7.

Fig. 3 and 4 are flowcharts showing an example of the machine learning method S1 according to embodiment 1. Fig. 5 and 6 are diagrams showing an example of the machine learning method S1 according to embodiment 1. Fig. 7 is a diagram showing an example of calculation of the evaluation index in the machine learning method S1 according to embodiment 1.

First, in step S100 (data set acquisition process), the machine learning device 1 acquires a data set D including data at each time point in the predetermined period P in the order of time series. The data set D may be data stored in the read-out storage unit 11, may be data received from another device via the communication unit 14, may be data recorded in a storage medium by referring to the storage medium via the device connection unit 15, or may be data measured by a measuring device via the device connection unit 15.

Next, in step S110 (data set dividing process), the period P is divided into a learning period PL and a verification period PT, the learning period PL is set as an initial candidate learning period PL 1, and the data set D is divided into learning data DL corresponding to the learning period PL and verification data DT corresponding to the verification period PT.

The period P is divided into a learning period PL (for example, 90%) and a verification period PT (for example, 10%) according to a predetermined data ratio of "9:1", for example. At this time, the verification period PT may be set discretely in the time series of the period P. For example, when the period P is 35 days, it is more preferable that the period P be dispersed in the time series of the period P such as one day in the early period (day 1 to 12), one day in the middle period (day 13 to 24), and one day in the later period (day 25 to 35), and the verification period PT can be set to be 6 th, 18 th, or 30 th. This can suppress the variation in the data included in the verification data.

The initial candidate learning period PL 1 shows an initial value of the candidate learning period PL i (where i=1, 2, R (R is an integer of 2 or more)) when the candidate learning period dividing process S130 and the learning period evaluating processes S140, S141 are repeatedly executed in learning period selecting processes S150 to S152 described later. "i" is a variable (index) indicating the number of repetitions, and is initialized to the number of repetitions i=1 in the data set dividing process S110. In the present embodiment, the upper limit value r=3 is used to describe the upper limit value of the number of repetitions.

Next, in step S130 (candidate learning period dividing process), the candidate learning period PL i is divided into a plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j (where j=1, 2,) and S (S is an integer of 2 or more). "j" is a variable (index) indicating an identifier for identifying the PLD i,j during the plurality of division learning. In addition, "S" represents the number of divisions when dividing the PLD i,j in the plurality of divided learning periods, and in the present embodiment, the description will be given with the number of divisions s=2. Therefore, in the present embodiment, the initial candidate learning period PL 1 in the case where the repetition number i is "1" is divided into two divided learning periods PLD 1,1、PLD1,2 in correspondence with the division number S being "2".

Further, the divided learning period PLD i,j of the plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j may be divided into a plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j so that each divided learning period PLD i,j includes a discrete period in the time series of the candidate learning periods PL i. For example, when the candidate learning period PL 1 is 32 days other than the 6 th, 18 th, and 30 th days of 35 days, the divided learning period PLD 1,1 is divided into 16 days including the 1 th to 5 th days, 19 th to 29 th days, and the divided learning period PLD 1,2 is divided into 16 days including the 7 th to 17 th days, 31 th to 35 th days. This can suppress the variation in data included in each of the plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j.

Next, in steps S140, S141 (learning period evaluation processing), machine learning of the learning model M is performed for each divided learning period PLD i,j using the divided learning data DLD i,j as the learning data DL corresponding to the divided learning period PLD i,j, thereby generating a learning period evaluation model ML i,j of each divided learning period PLD i,j. Then, the verification data DT is used to verify the learning period evaluation model ML i,j for each of the divided learning periods PLD i,j, whereby the evaluation index EL i,j of the learning period evaluation model ML i,j is calculated for each of the divided learning periods PLD i,j.

The evaluation index EL i,j of the learning period evaluation model ML i,j is, for example, an accuracy rate, a precision rate, a recall rate, a specificity rate, an F value, or the like, and a single evaluation index may be used, or a plurality of evaluation indexes may be used in combination. In the present embodiment, when the accuracy rate is used as the evaluation index EL i,j, in the case where the repetition number i is "1", the accuracy rate of the learning period evaluation model ML 1,1 in which the machine learning is performed using the divided learning period PLD 1,1 (the evaluation index EL 1,1 =36.5%) and the accuracy rate of the learning period evaluation model ML 1,2 in which the machine learning is performed using the divided learning period PLD 1,2 (the evaluation index EL 1,2 =23.6%) are calculated, respectively.

Next, in steps S150 to S152 (learning period selection processing), it is determined whether or not to end the repetition of the candidate learning period division processing S130 and the learning period evaluation processing S140 and S141 based on a predetermined end condition (step S150). The end condition is determined, for example, based on whether the repetition number i exceeds the repetition upper limit value R (r=3 in the present embodiment) when the repetition number i is increased (increment), whether the evaluation index EL i,j is out of a predetermined limit value (for example, lower limit value), or the like.

If the end condition is not satisfied (step S151: no), the divided learning period PLD i,j having a high evaluation index EL i,j is set as the next candidate learning period PL i (step S151) and the process returns to step S130, so that the above-described candidate learning period dividing process S130 and learning period evaluating process S140 are repeated, s141 until the end condition is satisfied. For example, in the present embodiment, when the repetition number i is "1", the divided learning period PLD 1,1 in which the evaluation index EL 1,1 is high is set as the next candidate learning period PL 2. Note that, in the case where the division number S is "2", one divided learning period PLD i,j having a high evaluation index EL i,j is set as the next candidate learning period PL i, but in the case where the division number S is "3 or more", one divided learning period PLD i,j having a highest evaluation index EL i,j may be set as the next candidate learning period PL i, or a plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j may be set as the next candidate learning period PL i in the order of the evaluation index EL i,j from high to low.

On the other hand, when the end condition is satisfied (yes in step S151), the repetition process ends, and the divided learning period PLD i,j having a high evaluation index EL i,j is selected as the learning target period PLF (step S152). Note that, in the case where the division number S is "2", one divided learning period PLD i,j in which the evaluation index EL i,j is high is set as the learning object period PLF, but in the case where the division number S is "3 or more", one divided learning period PLD i,j in which the evaluation index EL i,j is highest may be set as the learning object period PLF, or a plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j may be set as the learning object period PLF in the order of the evaluation index EL i,j from high to low.

Then, in step S160 (model 1 output process), the learning model M subjected to machine learning using the learning data DL corresponding to the learning object period PLF (hereinafter referred to as "learning object data DLF") is output as the 1 st learning completion model MF1. The storage unit 11 may be the output object of the 1 st learned model MF1, or may be another device. The 1 st learning model MF1 includes, for example, learned coefficients and parameters for imparting features to the learning model M. In the case where the 2 nd learned model MF1 is output in the 2 nd model output processing step S190, which will be described later, the output of the 1 st learned model MF1 may be omitted.

Next, in step S170 (learning data dividing process), the learning period PLC other than the learning object period PLF is divided into a plurality of sub-learning periods PLS k (k=2, 3..and T (T is an integer of 3 or more)), and the learning data DLC other than the learning object data DLF corresponding to the learning object period PLF is divided into a plurality of sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to the plurality of sub-learning periods PLS k. "T" represents the division number when dividing into the plurality of sub-learning data DLS k, and in the present embodiment, the division number t=7 (=2 R-1＝23 -1) is set to be divided into 7 sub-learning data DLS k (k=2, 3, 8).

Next, in steps S180 and S181 (additional period selection processing), the sub-learning data DLS k of the plurality of sub-learning data DLS k are used to verify the 1 st learned model MF1, whereby the evaluation index EF k of the 1 st learned model MF1 is calculated for each sub-learning period PLS k. Then, the sub-learning period PLS k in which the evaluation index EF k of the 1 st learning-completed model MF1 satisfies the predetermined addition condition is selected as the addition target period PLA. The addition condition is determined based on whether or not the evaluation index EF k exceeds a threshold value for the value of the evaluation index EF k, for example. As a result, one sub-learning period PLS k or a plurality of sub-learning periods PLS k may be selected as the addition target period PLA. Fig. 6 and 7 illustrate the case where two sub-learning periods PLS 2、PLS6 are selected as the addition target period PLA.

Then, in step S190 (model output processing 2), the learning model M subjected to machine learning using the learning data DL corresponding to at least one of the learning target period PLF and the additional target period PLA is output as a 2 nd learning completion model MF2. That is, the learning model M is machine-learned by using at least one of the learning object data DLF corresponding to the learning object period PLF and the sub-learning data DLS k (DLS 2、DLS6 in the example of fig. 6 and 7) corresponding to the additional object period PLA, and the learning model MF2 is output, and the series of processes is terminated. As the output object of the 2 nd learning model MF2, the storage unit 11 may be the same as the 1 st learning model MF1, or may be another device. The 2 nd learning model MF2 includes, for example, learning coefficients and parameters for imparting features to the learning model M, similarly to the 1 st learning model MF 1.

The 2 nd learning completion model MF2 may additionally perform machine learning (re-learning) of the 1 st learning completion model MF1 using the sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to the additional object period PLA, or may perform machine learning of the initialized learning model M using the learning object data DLF and the sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to the additional object period PLA. As the 2 nd learning completion model MF2, a plurality of 2 nd learning completion models MF2 may be output by performing machine learning of the learning model M by arbitrarily combining the learning object data DLF and the sub-learning data DLS k, and for example, a learning model M in which machine learning is performed by using the learning object data DLF and the sub-learning data DLS 2、DLS6, a learning model M in which machine learning is performed by using the learning object data DLF and the sub-learning data DLS 2, and a learning model M in which machine learning is performed by using the learning object data DLF and the sub-learning data DLS 6 may be output.

As described above, according to the machine learning method S1 of the present embodiment, the learning period selection processing S150 to S152 repeatedly performs the candidate learning period division processing S130 and the learning period evaluation processing S140 and S141, whereby the divided learning period PLD i,j having the evaluation index EL i,j of the learning period evaluation model ML i,j high is selected as the learning object period PLF, and the machine learning of the learning model M is performed using the learning object data DLF corresponding to the learning object period PLF. Therefore, the performance of the learning model based on machine learning can be improved.

In addition, by the additional period selection processing steps S180 and S181, the sub-learning period PLS k in which the evaluation index EF k of the 1 st learning completion model MF1 satisfies the predetermined additional condition is selected as the additional target period PLA, and the machine learning of the learning model M is performed using the sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to the additional target period PLA. Therefore, it is possible to improve the performance of the learning model while suppressing excessive learning caused by machine learning using the learning object data DLF by using the sub-learning data DLS k.

(Embodiment 2)

The basic configuration of the machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment is the same as that of embodiment 1, and details of the machine learning method S2 performed by the control unit 10 (machine learning unit 100) of the machine learning device 1 are different from those of the machine learning method S1 of embodiment 1. Specifically, in embodiment 1, the learning data dividing process S170 is performed after the 1 st model output process S160, whereas in embodiment 2, the learning data dividing process S220 is performed after the data set dividing process S210. The details of the machine learning method S2 performed by the control unit 10 (machine learning unit 100) of the machine learning device 1 according to the present embodiment will be described below with reference to fig. 8 to 12.

Fig. 8 and 9 are flowcharts showing an example of the machine learning method S2 according to embodiment 2. Fig. 10 and 11 are diagrams showing an example of the machine learning method S2 according to embodiment 2. Fig. 12 is a diagram showing an example of calculation of the evaluation index in the machine learning method S2 according to embodiment 2.

First, in step S200 (data set acquisition process), the machine learning device 1 acquires a data set D including data at each time point in the predetermined period P in the time-series order, as in step S100.

Next, in step S210 (data set dividing process), the period P is divided into a learning period PL and a verification period PT as in step S110, the learning period PL is set as an initial candidate learning period PL 1, and the data set D is divided into learning data DL corresponding to the learning period PL and verification data DT corresponding to the verification period PT.

The initial candidate learning period PL 1 shows an initial value of the candidate learning period PL i (i=1, 2,) when the candidate learning period dividing process S230 and the learning period evaluating processes S240, S241 are repeatedly executed in learning period selecting processes S250 to S252 described later. "i" is a variable (index) indicating the number of repetitions, and is initialized to the number of repetitions i=1 in the data set dividing process S210. In the present embodiment, the upper limit value r=3 is used to describe the upper limit value of the number of repetitions.

Next, in step S220 (learning data dividing process), the learning period PL is divided into a plurality of sub-learning periods PLs k (k=1, 2,..and T (S is an integer of 2 or more)), and the learning data DL is divided into a plurality of sub-learning data DLs k corresponding to the plurality of sub-learning periods PLs k. "T" indicates the division number when dividing into the plurality of sub-learning data DLS k, and in the present embodiment, the division number t=8 (=2 R＝23) is set to be divided into 8 sub-learning data DLS k (k=1, 3, 8).

Next, in step S230 (candidate learning period dividing process), the plurality of sub-learning periods PLs k included in the candidate learning period PL i are divided into a plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j (where j=1, 2,..and S (S is an integer of 2 or more)). "j" is a variable (index) indicating an identifier for identifying the PLD i,j during the plurality of division learning. In addition, "S" represents the number of divisions when dividing the PLD i,j in the plurality of divided learning periods, and in the present embodiment, the description will be given with the number of divisions s=2. Therefore, in the present embodiment, the initial candidate learning period PL 1 in the case where the repetition number i is "1" is divided into two divided learning periods PLD 1,1、PLD1,2 corresponding to the division number S of "2", but is divided into a divided learning period PLD 1,1 including four sub-learning periods PLs 1～PLS4 and a divided learning period PLD 1,2 including four sub-learning periods PLs 5～PLS8 at this time.

Further, the time series in the plurality of sub-learning periods PLs k may be randomly divided into the plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j so that the time series in the candidate learning period PL i includes discrete periods in each of the divided learning periods PLD i,j of the plurality of divided learning periods PLD i,j. For example, the split learning period PLD 1,1 may include four sub-learning periods PLS 1、PLS3、PLS5、PLS7, and the split learning period PLD 1,2 may include four sub-learning periods PLS 2、PLS4、PLS6、PLS8. This suppresses the variation in data contained in each of the plurality of sub-learning periods PLS k.

Next, in steps S240 and S241 (learning period evaluation processing), the machine learning of the learning model M is performed for each divided learning period PLD i,j using the sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to the sub-learning period PLS k included in the divided learning period PLD i,j, whereby the learning period evaluation model ML i,j for each divided learning period PLD i,j is generated. Then, verification of the learning period evaluation model ML i,j of each divided learning period PLD i,j is performed using the verification data DT, respectively, whereby the evaluation index EL i,j of the learning period evaluation model ML i,j is calculated for each divided learning period PLD i,j.

Next, in steps S250 to S252 (learning period selection processing), it is determined whether or not to end the repetition of the candidate learning period division processing S230 and the learning period evaluation processing S240 and S241 based on the predetermined end condition (step S250), as in steps S150 to S152. The end condition is determined, for example, based on whether the repetition number i exceeds the repetition upper limit value R (r=3 in the present embodiment) when the repetition number i is increased, whether the evaluation index EL i,j deviates from a predetermined limit value (for example, a lower limit value), or the like.

If the end condition is not satisfied (step S251: no), the divided learning period PLD i,j having a high evaluation index EL i,j is set as the next candidate learning period PL i (step S251) and the process returns to step S230, and the above-described candidate learning period dividing process S230 and learning period evaluation processes S240 and S241 are repeated until the end condition is satisfied.

On the other hand, when the end condition is satisfied (yes in step S251), the repetition process ends, and the sub-learning period PLS k included in the divided learning period PLD i,j having the high evaluation index EL i,j is selected as the learning target period PLF (step S252).

Then, in step S260 (model 1 output process), as in step S160, the learning model M subjected to machine learning using sub-learning data DLS k (hereinafter referred to as "learning object data DLF") corresponding to the learning object period PLF is output as a 1 st learning completed model MF1.

Next, in steps S280 and S281 (additional period selection processing), the 1 st learned model MF1 is verified using each of the sub-learning data DLS k of the plurality of sub-learning data DLS k other than the learning object data DLF corresponding to the learning object period PLF, whereby the evaluation index EF k of the 1 st learned model MF1 is calculated for each sub-learning period PLS k. Then, the sub-learning period PLS k in which the evaluation index EF k of the 1 st learning-completed model MF1 satisfies the predetermined addition condition is selected as the addition target period PLA. Fig. 11 and 12 illustrate the case where two sub-learning periods PLS 2、PLS6 are selected as the addition target period PLA.

Then, in step S290 (model output process 2), the learning model M subjected to machine learning using sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to at least one of the learning target period PLF and the additional target period PLA is output as a2 nd learning completion model MF2. That is, the learning model M is machine-learned by using at least one of the learning object data DLF corresponding to the learning object period PLF and the sub-learning data DLS k (DLS 2、DLS6 in the example of fig. 11 and 12) corresponding to the additional object period PLA, and the learning model MF2 is output, and the series of processing ends.

As described above, according to the machine learning method S2 of the present embodiment, the learning period selection processing S250 to S252 repeatedly performs the candidate learning period division processing S230 and the learning period evaluation processing S240 and S241, whereby the sub-learning period PLS k included in the divided learning period PLD i,j having the evaluation index EL i,j of the learning period evaluation model ML i,j is selected as the learning object period PLF, and the machine learning of the learning model M is performed using the learning object data DLF corresponding to the learning object period PLF. Therefore, the performance of the learning model based on machine learning can be improved.

In addition, in the additional period selection processing steps S280 and S281, the sub-learning period PLS k in which the evaluation index EF k of the 1 st learning completion model MF1 satisfies the predetermined additional condition is selected as the additional target period PLA, and the machine learning of the learning model M is performed using the sub-learning data DLS k corresponding to the additional target period PLA. Therefore, it is possible to improve the performance of the learning model while suppressing excessive learning caused by machine learning using the learning object data DLF by using the sub-learning data DLS k.
